source: This is why ZXNAME0000XZ can reach high arithmetic intensity. The same bytes are deliberately reused many times. As matrix dimensions and tile shapes change, however, that reuse can weaken. Small matrices, skinny dimensions, awkward tails, or insufficient parallelism may fail to amortize movement as effectively as a large well-shaped ZXNAME0001XZ.
zh: 这就是为什么ZXNAME0000XZ可以达到很高的算术强度。相同的字节被故意重复使用多次。然而，随着矩阵尺寸和图块形状的变化，这种重用可能会减弱。小矩阵、窄尺寸、笨拙的尾部或并行性不足可能无法像大型形状良好的 ZXNAME0001XZ 那样有效地摊销运动。
